text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for my debut! My running form still feels a little odd, but I just need to charge ahead in pursuit of the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Huh? I'm not aiming for the G1 races yet? But, Trainer, what does that even mean?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …I see. To aid my development, the first priority is to get me used to racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll start by accomplishing little things on my path to becoming my ideal princess!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After all, you are the one who will become Legendary Trainer. Let's combine our powers and charge ahead! Rraaagh! Princess☆Lasso!
